qualification.en: The line promises to defend the right to keep and bear arms. It says nothing about limits on who can buy guns or which guns can be sold, so it does not show where the party puts the weight. It is shown and not scored.

quote: DEFEND OUR CONSTITUTION, OUR BILL OF RIGHTS, AND OUR FUNDAMENTAL FREEDOMS, INCLUDING FREEDOM OF SPEECH, FREEDOM OF RELIGION, AND THE RIGHT TO KEEP AND BEAR ARMS

sourceTitle.en: 2024 Republican Party Platform, “Make America Great Again!” (PDF, undated; adopted by the RNC Platform Committee July 8, 2024, per the GOP press release of that date), p. 6

summary.en: The platform lists a promise to defend the Constitution, the Bill of Rights, and fundamental freedoms, including the right to keep and bear arms.
